user_input: Work directly in H:\App on the BottleBazaar repository. The user has supplied a 2047-line master development prompt in the attached pasted text; its core requirement is a production-ready liquor discovery, store catalogue, discount reservation, and in-store QR redemption platform with customer, merchant, and admin roles; real backend/database/auth/business logic; responsive mobile and admin UX; legal age gates, dry-day controls, inventory, analytics, testing, and documentation. Existing repo is a TypeScript monorepo with Expo mobile, React/Vite admin, Express/PostgreSQL/Redis API. Do not blindly replace working code. Inspect the full repository and implement the highest-value complete rewrite/modernization needed to satisfy the requirements end-to-end. Use existing stack unless a change is necessary. Fix root causes, preserve working functionality, and run targeted builds/tests. Return a concise report of files changed, behavior implemented, validation results, and any concrete blockers. Do not only produce a plan; execute implementation.
